product_metadata.title: iDesign Plastic Soap Saver, Holder Tray for Bathroom Counter, Shower, Kitchen, 0.75 in. x 3.25 in. x 4.75 in., Clear
features: BAR SOAP HOLDERS: Soap savers hold bar soap, sponges, scrubbies, dish brushes, razors, small accessories, and more. Great for use in bathroom, kitchen, shower, laundry room, or mudroom
DURABLE: Made of clear, durable plastic for years of quality use
FUNCTIONAL: Raised bumps along surface securely holds soap and raised based allows it to drain thoroughly and prevent it from becoming soggy
STURDY BASE: Textured base prevents soap holders from sliding around countertop
IDEAL SIZE: Each oval soap saver measures 0.75" x 3.25" x 4.75", perfect for your counter
description: The iDesign Soap Saver is your solution to keeping soap bars clean and dry. This oval bar soap holder is great for keeping soap or sponges within arm's reach at any sink. The trays are made of clear plastic for years of quality use. The raised bumps hold your soap or sponge to prevent any slipping off the base or around the counter. It raises your bar soap off the bottom of the dish allowing it to drain thoroughly and prevent your soap from becoming soggy and waterlogged. These soap holders are great to use in the bathroom, shower, kitchen, or laundry room. The iDesign Soap Saver measures 0.75" x 3.25" x 4.75", perfect for your counter space. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
